text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Fan Fest, where Umamusume show their appreciation to the fans who support them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special events are being held all over Tracen Academy for the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The training track seems to be a particularly popular spot, so I go to see what's happening.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Did you come to watch me get jiggy?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well, the truth is…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm… What am I going to do?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? You look worried.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, there's a small problem with the Fan Fest…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We have a sudden opening in the schedule for the training track.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You don't have enough people?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's right. We prepared some races, but due to how busy everyone is, we couldn't get enough students to participate.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey! If that's the case, I have an idea!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And that's how I came up with a plan for fans to join in, so we can all have fun together!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The track is normally closed to visitors, but I'll open it up and let everyone in!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Then, in the middle of the track, the younger students and I will hold a performance! How rad is that?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I took a page from those musicals that are super trendy right now!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, you don't know? You're so out of touch! Don't be left behind by the times!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's going to knock everyone's socks off, so come check it out!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky! The stage is set!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: The f-fluffy folding fans are ready too…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's get this show on the road!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Tracen! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky and the others on stage begin to energetically dance to techno beats.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Get down, everybody! Wooooo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nearby fans murmur amongst themselves as they gather around…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: This brings me back… I miss those days…

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I used to dance like crazy to music like this back in the day…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What? Why's everyone acting like this is some kind of throwback party?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Thank you for reminding me of the good ol' days!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Y-you're welcome…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, let's get into the groove, everybody! This music is, uh, funky fresh, right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While not the vibe that Maruzensky was hoping for, the performance still ends up going over well with a lot of people.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: This is what Maruzensky is all about!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Just what we hoped for! Loving the nostalgia! So groovy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wow! Everyone looks so happy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'd better do my part and wave this fluffy fan…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wahhh! Look at everyone having such a great time… It's gonna make me cryyy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I dunno what's going on, but you really know your stuff, Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You don't know? All the young ladies today love go-go dancing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's pump it up! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, it seems that leaving it up to Maruzensky was the right decision.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Especially those fluffy folding fans! They do add a certain fan-ciful flair… Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Maruzensky's performance ends in roaring success.
